rules.statement: A purchaser who has compromised with the claimant is not entitled to succeed in an action founded on eviction.
rules.supporting_quote: "Also [these actions fail] when the purchaser, before being condemned has voluntarily given up the thing to the plaintiff, or has compromised with him, or agreed to arbitration, or has submitted to the jurisdiction of an incompetent judge, or has referred the dispute to his adversary's oath, and has thus lost the thing by the ruling of an incompetent judge?"
